Houston medical SEO

Medical SEO in Houston for Clinics, Specialists, Urgent Care and ERs

Houston patients search across a huge metro, and they choose quickly: a Maps listing, a few reviews, a physician page and a phone number. Medical SEO in Houston is the work of making each of those accurate, clear and connected for your practice, then measuring which searches turn into calls and appointment requests. We are a Houston-based website repair and healthcare marketing team, working with doctors and practice administrators since 2013.

We work for practices, not patients. We do not provide medical care, and your clinicians approve anything clinical we publish.

Availability depends on specialty and ZIP code. In Houston, gastroenterology and primary care are reserved, and cardiology is reserved in several surrounding cities. Reserved practices can request a complimentary audit.
Request a free Houston practice review
Call (832) 266-7209
  • Houston-based since 2013
  • 1,000+ websites repaired
  • 500+ websites designed and redesigned
  • 7-day cancellation
  • Works alongside your current team
  • Why practices stall
  • Services
  • Process

Why good practices stall

Your practice may be excellent. Houston patients still need to find and understand it.

We usually find the same four problems when a Houston practice is not getting enough patients from search. None is dramatic; together they are expensive.

Website problems

Slow mobile pages, broken forms, crawl errors and a single 'services' page that tries to cover everything.

Google Maps problems

Wrong categories, outdated hours, offices that share one listing, and few recent reviews.

Content problems

Thin physician and service pages, or copied text that does not match what the practice actually offers.

AI search visibility problems

AI assistants describe the practice vaguely or inaccurately because the site does not state its facts clearly.

Choose the page that matches your practice

  1. SpecialistsGI, cardiology, plastic surgery and more
  2. Primary careAudit only in Houston
  3. Urgent careHouston urgent care SEO
  4. Emergency roomsHouston ER SEO
  5. DentalHouston dental SEO

Services

Medical SEO and healthcare marketing services for Houston practices

Healthcare SEO in Houston differs from general SEO: more locations, stricter content review, ad-policy limits and patients who often decide quickly. We commit to the work and the reporting, not to rankings or patient counts.

Technical website optimization

Speed, mobile layout, crawl errors, forms, security and structured data, fixed by the team that has repaired 1,000+ websites.

Local SEO across Greater Houston

A Google profile and page for each office, consistent across directories, with a review routine your staff can run.

Physician and service pages

Pages for each provider and each service, approved by your clinicians and linked to the offices that offer them.

Google Ads for immediate demand

Search campaigns for chosen services or offices, with healthcare ad-policy review and dedicated landing pages.

AI-search readiness

Clear practice facts and answer-style content so AI search tools can describe you accurately. No guaranteed mentions.

Conversion and reporting

Clear calls to action, shorter forms and monthly reporting of calls and requests by office and source.

Social media can support visibility and reviews, but it rarely replaces search for patients who need care soon; we advise on it and coordinate with whoever runs it. More detail: healthcare SEO service, healthcare AI search optimization.

Process and evidence

How we work with Houston practices

Being in Houston means we can meet at your office when helpful. Most work runs on a shared task list with a monthly review.

  1. Free review

    A screen-shared look at your website, Maps listings and current visibility, with no obligation.

  2. Assess and back up

    A full audit, with a backup of your site before we change anything.

  3. Fix foundations

    Technical repairs, office listings and tracking.

  4. Improve content and campaigns

    Physician, service and office pages; Google Ads if wanted.

  5. Measure and refine

    Monthly reporting by office and source, and ongoing support.

Illustrative audit excerpt

Typical Houston practice findings

Format example, not a client.

  • Katy and Sugar Land offices share one Google profile.
  • Services page lists 22 services with no individual pages.
  • Appointment form fails on iPhone Safari.
  • No separate tracking for calls and forms.

Who does what: we fix, build and report. Your practice handles scheduling, patient communication and clinical approval.

Houston coverage

Local SEO across Greater Houston, and which specialties are available

We are based in Houston and work with practices across the metro, in Houston itself and in separate cities such as Pearland, Sugar Land, Katy, Pasadena and Baytown, and communities like Cypress, Spring and The Woodlands. Availability is set by specialty and ZIP code.

Specialty offers

Houston specialty pages

  • Cardiology marketing in Houston (partly reserved)
  • Plastic surgery marketing in Houston
  • Gastroenterology website audit in Houston (reserved)
Existing pages

Urgent care, ER and dental

  • Urgent care SEO Houston
  • ER SEO Houston
  • Dental SEO Houston
Reserved in Houston

Primary care and GI

Primary care and gastroenterology are reserved in Houston. We offer a complimentary audit and consultation instead of ongoing service.

Texas availability overview

Engagement and pricing

Short projects or ongoing work, satisfaction-based, cancellable with 7 days’ notice. Proposals are scope-based after review, with the management fee, ad spend paid to Google, one-time website work and optional services listed separately. See our healthcare marketing cost guide and the healthcare marketing hub.

Questions and consultation

Frequently asked questions about medical SEO in Houston

Direct answers for Houston doctors and administrators.

What is medical SEO, and how does it help Houston doctors?

It is the work of making your practice easy to find and understand in Google, Maps and AI search, and easy to contact once found: technical repair, accurate office listings, clear physician and service pages, and tracking. In a metro as large as Houston, office-level accuracy matters as much as content.

How long does medical SEO take to show results?

Fixes to listings and broken pages can help within weeks. Content and authority usually take several months. We report progress monthly and never promise a date for a ranking.

Can SEO help my clinic appear in 'near me' searches?

It can improve your chances: those results lean on your Google profile, proximity, reviews and how clearly your site states what you offer at each office. Proximity is outside anyone’s control.

Do you provide SEO services for different medical specialties?

Yes, including primary care, urgent care, ERs, dental and specialists. Availability depends on specialty and ZIP code; see the coverage section above.

Why is my medical practice website not ranking on Google?

Common causes are technical errors, thin or duplicated service pages, inconsistent office data and few recent reviews. A free review usually identifies the main ones.

Do you also run Google Ads for Houston practices?

Yes, where it fits, with landing pages built for each campaign and ad spend paid directly to Google.

Do we need a medical marketing agency near us in Houston?

It helps if you want in-person meetings, and we are in Houston. More important is honest reporting and healthcare understanding.

Request a free Houston practice review

Tell us your specialty and office ZIP codes. We confirm availability and reply by email.
